title: The Dynamic Search for the Minimal Dynamic Extension
summary: Identifying the dynamic precompensator that renders a nonlinear control system feedback linearizable is a challenging problem. Researchers have explored the problem -- dynamic feedback linearization -- and produced existence conditions and constructive procedures for the dynamic precompensator. These remain, in general, either computationally expensive or restrictive. Treating the challenge as intrinsic, this article views the problem as a search problem over a category.
